issue_audit.title: [Functionalization] Incorrect values after in-place mutation of a non-overlapping transposed unfold view
issue_audit.rationale: The word windows describes tensor unfold/sliding windows, not the operating system.

excerpts:
fix would be to make `unfold_inverse` preserve the original base tensor's strides by allocating the output with the same layout before scattering the windows back.

I'll also add the reproducer from this issue to `test/test_functionalization.py` and check that both the values and strides match the eager result.

This seems separate from #198102 and #205026, which deal with gapped windows. Here, `size == step`, so the windows cover the base tensor exactly.

AI assistance was used during the investigation, and I verified the findings against the source code.
